Two families, one idea: small open models that run where the work happens. ANT returns calibrated decisions; Moth turns Italian speech with English terms into text in a browser tab.

ANT family

ANT-4B and ANT-08B

Two System 1 decision models, the same training recipe on two backbones: a 4.2B encoder for the hard semantic cases, and a 753M one that fits on a laptop.

Speech-to-text models

Moth family

Moth and Moth 50 Coming soon

A 19.7 MB speech-to-text model for Italian speech with English terms inside it. It runs in a browser tab, on a CPU, and the audio never leaves the machine. A larger sibling, under 50 MB, is in development.
